offence: Penalty for begging (habitual beggar causing annoyance / nuisance in public place)
arrestText: May not arrest without warrant (no general Act arrest power for s.4; max 2 years — CPC default for other laws). s.3 allows taking a destitute person into charge for welfare-home inquiry, which is not the s.4 offence power
punishment: Fine not exceeding $3,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 2 years

offence: Escape from lawful custody of welfare home / police under the Act
arrestText: May arrest without warrant only if reasonably suspected of s.16 or s.17 and refuses or fails to accompany a police officer to, or appear before, a Magistrate's Court (DPA s.18). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence
bailText: Bailable (max 6 months — CPC default for other laws)

offence: Behaving in disorderly manner in welfare home
arrestText: May arrest without warrant only if reasonably suspected of s.16 or s.17 and refuses or fails to accompany a police officer to, or appear before, a Magistrate's Court (DPA s.18). Not a general warrantless-arrest offence
bailText: Bailable (max 2 years — CPC default for other laws)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $3,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 2 years
